records.name: Goa University (Marine Science)
records.description: Goa University's Department of Marine Sciences offers graduate and postgraduate programs in oceanography and marine sciences, leveraging the state's unique coastal and estuarine ecosystems for field research. The department has strong ties with NIO Goa and offers M.Sc. programs in marine biology, chemical oceanography, and coastal management. Its location on the Konkan coast makes it ideal for marine ecology and monsoon research studies.

records.name: Berhampur University (Marine Science)
records.description: Berhampur University in Odisha's Ganjam district offers postgraduate and research programs in marine sciences, with access to the ecologically rich Bay of Bengal coastline. The Department of Marine Sciences focuses on tropical coastal ecology, fisheries biology, and marine pollution research. The university collaborates with Chilika Development Authority and other regional bodies for applied marine research.

records.name: JNU School of Social Sciences
records.description: Jawaharlal Nehru University's School of Social Sciences in New Delhi is one of India's most prestigious centers for social science research and education, known for its interdisciplinary approach to economics, sociology, history, and political science. It offers M.A., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs and has produced many of India's prominent academics, journalists, and public intellectuals. JNU's vibrant research culture and scholarship programs make it accessible to students from diverse backgrounds.

records.name: Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics
records.description: Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics (GIPE) Pune is a deemed university and one of India's oldest and most respected centers for economics research and education, founded in 1930. It offers postgraduate and doctoral programs in economics with specializations in agricultural economics, development economics, and public policy. GIPE has a strong tradition of applied economics research contributing to Maharashtra's rural and agricultural policy frameworks.

records.name: IGIDR Mumbai
records.description: Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR) Mumbai is an advanced research institute in development economics, established by the Reserve Bank of India. It offers M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs in economics with a focus on energy economics, financial markets, and development economics. IGIDR is known for its rigorous quantitative training and strong research output in top international economics journals.

records.name: Government Polytechnics (Various States)
records.description: Government Polytechnics across various Indian states offer diploma-level technical education in engineering, technology, and applied sciences, regulated by AICTE. These institutions provide three-year diploma programs for students after Class 10, forming a crucial pathway into technical careers and lateral entry into engineering degree programs. They are key feeder institutions for the industrial workforce in manufacturing, construction, and electrical trades.

records.name: ITI (Industrial Training Institutes)
records.description: Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) are vocational training centers established under the Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, offering trade-specific courses under the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT). They provide one to two-year programs in trades like electrician, fitter, welder, mechanic, and IT&ESM, equipping students with industry-ready technical skills. ITIs are the backbone of India's skilled workforce pipeline, with thousands of institutes across every state and union territory.

records.name: AICTE Approved Polytechnics
records.description: AICTE Approved Polytechnics across India offer diploma programs in engineering and technology disciplines approved by the All India Council for Technical Education. These institutions follow standardized curricula and are eligible for state and central government scholarships, making technical education accessible to students from economically weaker sections. They serve as critical entry points into industries like manufacturing, automotive, electronics, and civil construction.

records.name: IIT Bombay (Electrical)
records.description: IIT Bombay's Department of Electrical Engineering is one of the most renowned in India, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs across power systems, control systems, signal processing, and microelectronics. The department has produced leading engineers and entrepreneurs in India's technology sector and maintains strong research partnerships with companies like Tata Power, Siemens, and international universities. It hosts state-of-the-art research labs in VLSI, power electronics, and communications.

records.name: IIT Delhi (Electrical)
records.description: IIT Delhi's Department of Electrical Engineering is consistently ranked among India's top electrical engineering departments, known for research in power systems, photonics, VLSI design, and communication networks. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and has extensive sponsored research from government agencies and multinational corporations. Alumni from this department hold senior positions at global tech companies, research institutions, and power utilities worldwide.
